purpose: Native personal symptom diary; no ESAS-r/IPOS instrument, automatic clinical total, triage or treatment recommendation is claimed.
sourceReview: Today and Daily care route directly to the native diary; existing mood check-ins remain readable.
Structured versioned entries use the existing CareItem/Room/cloud record route and readable export.
Save requires the captured selected person and existing write permission; existing record identity and revision are preserved.
Editor closes on person switch; read-only views hide mutation actions and disable saving.
No rating is preselected; zero and explicit not rated remain different. Observation context and attribution are stored.
Baseline/previous comparisons use actual earlier compatible records for the same person; subjective change is separately attributed.
English/Hindi choices, editing, removal with confirmation, sharing and malformed/legacy record handling are implemented.
